OLUBADAN CORONATION TRAFFIC ADVISORY

As Ibadan prepares for the coronation of the 44th Olubadan of Ibadanland, His Royal Majesty Oba Rashidi Ladoja, on Friday, 26 September 2025, certain roads around Mapo Hall will be closed from 7:00 a.m.

The routes include Beere Junction inward Mapo Hall; Born Photo Junction inward Oja’ba; Idi-Arere Junction inward Oja’ba; and Itamerin Junction inward Mapo Hall.

Guests are advised to use the designated parking areas:

1. Ibadan North LG Car Park, Agodi (in front of the Immigration Office).
2. The Football Field beside Yemetu Police Station.
3. Liberty Stadium, Oke Ado.

Shuttle buses will convey invited guests from the designated parking areas to Mapo Hall.
Kindly plan your movement accordingly.

‼️WEEK OF ACTION AT THE UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY‼️🌍🇵🇸

From Palestine to the Philippines, from Sudan to Congo, our struggle is one. This week we rise for collective liberation and to build power against a world that normalizes genocide in Gaza. Bring your flags, your signs, your noisemakers, and your courage. Hold down the space, confront the delegates, and demand to know what they’re doing to stop the genocide in Gaza. There can be no business as usual while a genocide continues to unfold. 

Wednesday, September 24
4:00 PM: BK Jail Support on the Link between the IOF, NYPD & Cop Cities

Thursday, September 25
3:00 PM Teach in + March: Bahain NG Protesta! Starting at Bryant Park

5:30 PM Rally: Bahain NG Protesta! | Consulate general of the Philippines

ALL DAY RALLY: No Rest for the Wicked! All Our Struggles are Connected

Friday, September 26
9:00 AM: Doctors Against Genocide - Gaza’s hospitals are taking their last breath.
